body: I was honored to write a foreword for this book by my friend, Samuel Lee, a truly fascinating and creative person who lives what he teaches. It deserves wide readership, especially among charismatics and classic Pentecostals. What an amazing journey so many of us are on, coming from so many diverse backgrounds, but waking up in the same world facing the same challenges, and bumping into the same Holy Spirit “in whom we live and move and have our being!”
